user_request: 继续改进：运行方案、检查副作用、在dev上验证的准备

design.prompt: Keep the prepared reviewer prompt frozen; no additional error-derived rules in this batch.
design.test: All 426 review requests; historical few-shot control; exploratory after test-informed prompt editing.
design.dev: Both fixed LLM prompts on all 420 samples, alternating pair submission order by sorted sample ID; no gold in requests.
design.analysis: Only after complete collection; no mid-run label inspection, example selection, prompt updates, or stopping by observed score.
design.primary_validation: Paired dev macro-F1 difference; paired bootstrap B=10000 seed=20261103.
design.secondary: Accuracy McNemar, all four classes P/R/F1/support/FP/FN, corrected/regressed/both-wrong, parse failures retained.
design.decision: Report positive, null or negative results. A positive macro-F1 difference alone is not evidence all four classes improved. CI overlapping zero is inconclusive for improvement.
design.no_ensemble: No Sun-guided LLM repair, disagreement routing, Gold-guided routing or oracle selection.

dev_exposure.prompt_development: Available versioned evidence uses test errors and train labels; dev texts previously used for overlap checking, no dev label-based prompt selection found.
dev_exposure.supervised_baselines: dev already used for baseline model selection; not globally unused, not a new external test set.

limitations: test是看过错误后修改prompt的探索性历史对照，不能作为盲测。
dev仅是这两版冻结LLM提示词的留出验证；同语料、监督基线已用过dev，并非全项目未使用过的新数据。
若查看dev后继续调prompt，dev即转为开发数据；后续独立泛化主张需另有未参与调整的数据。
同期双臂按样本交错提交仍不能完全消除服务后端、并发与缓存差异。
首有效clause投影、残缺输入和标签歧义仍保留，不改Gold或评价器。
实际得分由真实完整返回决定；理论组合上界不是本实验的性能结果。
data_policy: Source German sentences, 18 train demonstrations, full prompts/responses remain git-ignored locally; approved requests go only to the official API.
